SELECT sf.location_id, sf.location_path, sf.item_id, sf.item_name, sf.lot_id, sf.lot_number, sf.serial_number, sf.unit_name, sf.quantity, sf.expiry_date FROM reporting_stock_flat sf WHERE sf.household_id = #{householdId} AND sf.item_id = #{itemId} AND sf.location_id = #{locationId}
AND sf.item_id IN (SELECT id FROM catalog_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId})
AND sf.item_id IN (SELECT id FROM catalog_item WHERE brand_id = #{brandId})
ORDER BY sf.location_path, sf.item_name, sf.lot_number

SELECT sf.lot_id, sf.lot_number, sf.serial_number, sf.item_id, sf.item_name, sf.unit_name, sf.location_id, sf.location_path, sf.quantity, sf.expiry_date, (sf.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_until_expiry FROM reporting_stock_flat sf WHERE sf.household_id = #{householdId} AND sf.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND sf.expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE + #{withinDays} * INTERVAL '1 day' AND sf.quantity > 0 AND sf.item_id = #{itemId} AND sf.location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY sf.expiry_date ASC

SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.low_stock_threshold, i.low_stock_mode, COALESCE(SUM(sf.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_item i LEFT JOIN reporting_stock_flat sf ON sf.item_id = i.id AND sf.household_id = i.household_id WHERE i.household_id = #{householdId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.low_stock_mode = 'CUSTOM' AND i.low_stock_threshold IS NOT NULL AND i.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.low_stock_threshold, i.low_stock_mode HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sf.quantity), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(sf.quantity), 0) / NULLIF(i.low_stock_threshold, 0)) ASC
